title: The Dark Truth About Tumbbad #Shorts
description:
Evolution does not optimize for happiness — Tumbbad shows exactly where that breaks. Tumbbad is a 2018 folk horror film directed by Rahi Anil Barve and Anand Gandhi, and written by Mitesh Shah, Adesh Prasad, Barve, and Anand Gandhi. It stars Sohum Shah in the lead role as Vinayak Rao, and follows the story of his search for a hidden 20th century treasure in the Indian village of Tumbbad, Maharashtra.

The selfish-gene reading of Tumbbad makes it less romantic and far more precise. For their research, they used photograph's from the 18th and 19th century during the British Raj. The interiors of the cave were shot at the Purandare Wada near Pune.
